title: 第一卷 第11章 离开小院第一卷 第12章 入东玄城
lines: 下午，秦烈出了趟门。
明天就要去东玄城了，这是他穿越之后第一次出远门，该准备的东西还是要准备一下。
黑山镇地方不大，街上也没有多少铺子。
秦烈也就买了些干粮，然后又买了两身换洗的衣服。
至于兵器，他倒是不着急买。
黑山镇这种小地方，能买到的刀，最多也就比柴刀强一点。
而且他明天就要去东玄城的镇妖司，那边说不定会发兵器。
要是真发了，那他花的不就是冤枉钱了吗？
要是不发的话，那等到了东玄城再买也不迟。
大城市的东西总该比黑山镇这种小地方的要好一些。
买完自己的，秦烈又在街上转了一圈。
最后买了一口大水缸，一个石磨，还有一头驴。
这几样价格都不便宜，但确实也是刚需。
水缸能存水，柳芸娘以后就不用一天到晚往井边跑了。
石磨能磨粮，家里有了粮，也能多做点吃的。
驴就更不用说了，挑水、拉柴、去镇上换东西，都用得上。
这些东西不是消耗品，家里一直都能用得上。
他要是不买的话，柳芸娘手里就算有三两银子，多半也舍不得买。
一方面是有照顾柳芸娘和两个孩子的心思，不过秦烈心里还有另一个打算。
他想试一下，这样子能不能增加点家业值。
既然叫家业，那就不可能靠杀妖增加。
添置点东西，然后把日子过好了，应该也算是壮大家业吧。
如果能增加点家业值的话，那这钱花的就值得。
等秦烈牵着驴，又雇人帮忙把水缸和石磨送到张家小院儿的时候，柳芸娘正在厨房里做饭呢。
她听见院门外的动静，出来一看，整个人都愣住了。
“秦兄弟，你这是……”
她看着那口大水缸，又看看石磨和那头驴，一时间没反应过来。
“你买这些做什么？这得花不少银子吧？”
秦烈把驴牵进院子拴好，随口说：“我明天就走了，给家里添置点能用的东西。”
柳芸娘赶紧走上前。
“这怎么行？三两银子你都给了。”
“这些东西不便宜，你明天还要去东玄城，到处都得花钱。”
“水我多挑几趟就行了，磨粮我去别人家借也成，这驴就更不用买了，家里又没多少东西要拉。”
她话说的又急又快，眼神里也流露出几分心疼。
“嫂子，我现在已经进了镇妖司了，以后每个月都有俸禄。”
“再说了，这些东西买回来又不是用一次就没了。”
“有了这些东西之后，你以后也能轻松不少。”
柳芸娘听到这儿，眼眶微微一红。
“可你也不能总是想着我们啊！”
“你明天都走了，到了东玄城，人生地不熟的，自己身上也得多留点银子呀！”
秦烈摆了摆手。
“我心里有数。再说嫂子救过我的命，张大哥以前也接济过我，这些就当是我还这个人情。”
content_en:
In the afternoon, Qin Lie went out.
He is going to Dongxuan City tomorrow. This is his first trip since time travel, so he still needs to prepare the things he needs to prepare.
Heishan Town is not a big place and there are not many shops on the streets.
Qin Lie also bought some dry food, and then bought two changes of clothes.
As for weapons, he was in no hurry to buy them.
In a small place like Black Mountain Town, the knives you can buy are at best a little better than hatchets.
Moreover, he will go to the Demon Suppression Department in Dongxuan City tomorrow, and weapons may be distributed there.
If it really happened, wouldn't he have spent money in vain?
If you don't give it away, it's not too late to wait until you get to Dongxuan City to buy it.
Things in big cities should always be better than those in small places like Black Mountain Town.
After buying his own, Qin Lie walked around the street again.
Finally, I bought a large water tank, a stone mill, and a donkey.
These are not cheap, but they are indeed necessary.
The water tank can store water, and Liu Yunniang will no longer have to run to the well all day long.
The stone mill can grind grain. If you have grain at home, you can also make more food.
Not to mention donkeys, which are useful for carrying water, pulling firewood, and going to town to exchange things.
These items are not consumables and can always be used at home.
If he didn't buy it, Liu Yunniang would probably be reluctant to buy it even if she had three taels of silver.
On the one hand, he wanted to take care of Liu Yunniang and the two children, but Qin Lie had another plan in mind.
He wanted to try to see if this could increase the value of his family fortune.
Since it is called family business, it cannot be increased by killing monsters.
Buying some things and living a better life should be considered as strengthening the family business.
If it can increase the value of the family property, then the money is worth spending.
When Qin Lie took the donkey and hired someone to help deliver the water tank and stone mill to the Zhang family's courtyard, Liu Yunniang was cooking in the kitchen.
She heard the movement outside the courtyard gate, and when she came out to see it, she was stunned.
"Brother Qin, what are you..."
She looked at the big water tank, then at the stone mill and the donkey, but didn't react for a while.
"What did you buy these for? It costs a lot of money, right?"
Qin Lie led the donkey into the yard and tied it up, and said casually: "I will leave tomorrow to buy some useful things for the house."
Liu Yunniang stepped forward quickly.
"How can this be done? You gave me three taels of silver."
"These things are not cheap. You have to go to Dongxuan City tomorrow and you have to spend money everywhere."
"I can just pick up water a few more times, and I can borrow it from someone else's house to grind grain. There's no need to buy this donkey. I don't have much to haul at home."
She spoke urgently and quickly, and her eyes showed some distress.
"Sister-in-law, I have now entered the Demon Suppression Department, and I will receive a salary every month from now on."
"Besides, these things won't be used once and then gone."
"After you have these things, you will be much more relaxed in the future."
When Liu Yuniang heard this, her eyes turned slightly red.
"But you can't always think about us!"
"You are leaving tomorrow. When you arrive in Dongxuan City, you are not familiar with the place. You should keep some money on yourself!"
Qin Lie waved his hand.
"I know it well. Besides, my sister-in-law has saved my life, and Brother Zhang has helped me before, so this is my way of repaying this favor."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 11 Leaving the courtyard Volume 1 Chapter 12 Entering Dongxuan City
